title: Command Palette Fails to Find Anything After...
summary: After prolonged uptime with nightly hibernation, Command Palette file-search results reportedly stop appearing for simple queries.

judgment.rationale: The report gives a lifecycle trigger (days of uptime with hibernation) and failing surface (file-search results), but does not identify whether the provider stops refreshing, its index becomes stale, or the palette view stops receiving updates. Preserve the sleep/wake sequence before selecting a narrow fix.
evidence: The reporter says file-search results disappear after leaving Windows running for days and hibernating nightly.
Simple queries reportedly continue to return no file-section results.
The report is on PowerToys 0.99.1 and has no follow-up discussion.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the reported hibernate/resume sequence and inspect the failing provider boundary.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reported lifecycle symptom is an applicable bug; the maintainer should reproduce and identify the stale boundary before implementation.

proposed_fixes.title: Restore Command Palette file results after long sleep/uptime
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: a file-search provider or its result publication path is not refreshed after repeated hibernate/resume cycles; the issue does not establish whether indexing or UI delivery is responsible.
plan: Reproduce on a current build with file search enabled and record whether the provider/index remains responsive after resume.
Trace provider lifecycle and result publication across suspend/resume before changing refresh behavior.
Fix only the demonstrated stale lifecycle transition and add a focused resume-cycle regression test.
verification: After repeated hibernate/resume cycles, simple file queries again produce results equivalent to a fresh-start baseline without restarting PowerToys.

confidence.rationale: The report gives a concrete lifecycle trigger, but the faulty provider/index/UI boundary is not established.

actions.label: Approve investigation of file-search resume behavior

reproduce.title: Restore Command Palette file results after long sleep/uptime
reproduce.version_requirement: Reported PowerToys 0.99.1; compare with current stable build
prerequisites: Command Palette file search enabled with a known local test file
setup: Record a known searchable test file and confirm it appears after a fresh start.
steps: 1. Leave PowerToys running through repeated hibernate/resume cycles over several days, or the longest repeatable interval available.
2. After each resume, open Command Palette and search for the known file using a simple query.
3. Record when results stop appearing and compare with a fresh PowerToys restart.
reproduce.expected_result: File-search results continue after resume; if a provider lifecycle fault is confirmed, restarting PowerToys should restore results until the recurrence is fixed.
